SELECT gagr.*,
ct.build_name AS data_name,
ct.conf_name AS data_name,
ct.db_name AS data_name,
ct.field_flag AS data_name,
ct.table_comment AS data_name,
ct.column_comment AS data_name,
ct.template_name AS data_name,
gag.group_name FROM gen_all_group_rel gagr LEFT JOIN gen_all_group gag ON gagr.group_id = gag.id
LEFT JOIN code_build ct ON gagr.data_id = ct.id
LEFT JOIN code_build_conf ct ON gagr.data_id = ct.id
LEFT JOIN code_datasource ct ON gagr.data_id = ct.id
LEFT JOIN code_field_mapping ct ON gagr.data_id = ct.id
LEFT JOIN code_table ct ON gagr.data_id = ct.id
LEFT JOIN code_table_column ct ON gagr.data_id = ct.id
LEFT JOIN code_template ct ON gagr.data_id = ct.id
WHERE gagr.group_id = #{pageDTO.groupId} AND gagr.group_type = #{pageDTO.groupType}
